jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering - CoCounsel Legal
jobs.description:
Job Description

CoCounsel Legal is Thomson Reuters' AI assistant for legal professionals. This role leads the part of it that makes it adaptable: the agent's ability to take on a customer's skills, connect to third-party systems, and remember what matters to each legal team.

As Director, you will lead multiple engineering teams building the core of the CoCounsel Legal product. Your teams will let law firms and corporate legal departments add their own skills, connect their own tools through MCP integrations, and make CoCounsel work the way they do.

You will also contribute directly to the agent itself. This work carries high stakes for confidentiality, permissions, and customer control, and you will make the security and architecture decisions that earn customer trust.

We want an AI-native engineering leader who works at the forefront of AI-assisted development. You already build with coding agents and agent workflows, and you set the standard for how your teams do the same. You stay hands-on, make sound technical trade-offs, and plan strategically while the product and customer needs are still taking shape.

This is a hybrid role based in one of our hub locations: Minneapolis/Eagan, Dallas, Toronto, or New York City. Hybrid means two to three days a week in the office, depending on the role.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop multiple engineering teams, and build the leadership layer (managers and technical leads) as the scope grows. Own workforce planning, hiring, performance, calibration, and succession.
Own the engineering vision and delivery for how customers extend CoCounsel Legal. This includes custom skills and the tools to create, test, version, share, and retire them.
Lead the design and delivery of MCP and third-party integrations, so customers can connect their own systems and tools to the CoCounsel agent safely and at scale.
Contribute directly to the CoCounsel agent, working with Agent Core and Science on how it uses skills, tools, memory, and context.
Own agent memory at the user and organization levels. Start narrow, prove each step with evidence, and expand.
Make customization safe for the enterprise. Own the security model for sharing and integrations, including least-privilege permissions, audit logging, and administrator controls. Lead the response to complex security and privacy issues, working with Security and Privacy.
Make evaluation a release gate. Work with Science and subject-matter experts so that skills and agent behavior are tested for quality, accuracy, and fidelity to customer instructions before they ship.
Set the technical direction. Decide what to build, buy, or partner on, favor reusable primitives over one-off features, and make clear trade-offs among speed, quality, security, and cost.
Set the standard for AI-native engineering. Define how your teams use coding agents and AI tools to build, review, and verify work, and model that practice yourself.
Stay hands-on. Spend at least 30% of your time on technical work such as design and code review, prototyping, and building with AI coding agents.
Build a culture of end-to-end ownership. Your teams design, build, deploy, and operate their services, including on-call, SLOs, and incident response. You take part in the escalation path for major incidents.
Measure outcomes, not activity. Use DORA metrics alongside quality and developer-experience measures, and fund the next stage of work through short, evidence-based checkpoints.
Own the investment envelope across people, cloud, AI inference, and vendor services.
Work directly with customers and Product, including beta customers. Explain engineering trade-offs clearly to business and executive stakeholders.
Partner with peers in Agent Core, Application Experience, Platform, and Corporate Integrations to keep CoCounsel coherent as a product.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of software engineering experience, including proven success leading multiple teams and leading through other managers or technical leads
Hands-on engineering work within the last two to three years, and the ability to contribute to design, code, and architecture
Hands-on experience building agentic systems or LLM-based agent features, such as tool use, prompt and instruction management, memory, retrieval, or context management, and a practical sense of where they fail
AI-native ways of working: daily, proficient use of AI coding tools and agent setups to do engineering work, and experience setting team norms for verifying agent-generated work
Experience building integrations with third-party systems, and experience with MCP or comparable tool and plugin protocols
Experience building platforms that customers configure and extend, such as skills, plugins, extension frameworks, or workflow and automation features
Strong backend foundation, including API design, authentication and authorization, multi-tenancy, versioning, data lifecycle, event-driven processing, and observability
Experience making sound technical trade-offs and resolving complex security issues, particularly where third-party access and customer data are involved
Experience evaluating agentic systems and building evaluation into the release process, working with science and subject-matter experts
Experience leading teams that operate what they build, with production on-call, SLOs, and incident response
Proven strategic planning: setting direction under ambiguity and re-planning based on evidence from working software and customers
Accountability for workforce planning, budget, and build-versus-buy decisions
Proficiency in Python and strong engineering fundamentals, including cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), CI/CD, and testing strategy
Understanding of the privacy, security, and compliance obligations of handling confidential and privileged customer data
Clear, persuasive communication with engineers, product partners, and senior business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building agent memory, such as user and organization memory, memory search and inspection, and giving users and administrators control over what is kept
Experience building tools that let non-engineers create and improve agent behavior, such as skill or prompt authoring, test chats, and review workflows with versioning and rollback
Background in legal technology, or in enterprise software for legal, compliance, or risk functions, including customers who need confidentiality, ethical walls, and audit trails
Experience with enterprise administration and sharing models, such as groups, roles, org-level publishing, and usage reporting
Experience running customer beta programs and turning feedback into a path to general availability
Experience building a new product line alongside an established one, and organizing teams around shared platforms
Contributions to open-source agent, MCP, or developer-tooling projects

New Position: This position is open due to an existing vacancy to support our evolving business needs.

What’s in it For You?

Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

jobs.title: Director, Public & Alternative Investments, Data Platforms
jobs.description:
Purpose. Performance. People.

Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.

With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.

For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.

The Role

As Director, Data Engineering for the Public Markets and Alternate Assets (PMAA) team, you will build and publish the enterprise market data products that power investment strategies across our public markets and alternate assets businesses. Partnering closely with your business-aligned product owner, you will lead a talented team of data engineers and analysts and own the end-to-end lifecycle of PMAA data, from vendor and internal feeds through to trusted, well-documented data products used by investment teams, analytics platforms and AI agents. You will set the technical direction for a modern AWS data platform, establish the semantic and knowledge graph foundations that connect data across asset classes, and ensure every data product meets the standards of timeliness, quality, licensing compliance and control that investment decisions demand.

The Team

CPP Investments invests across public and private markets, supported by technology and data capabilities that enable informed investment decisions and long-term value creation.

Within PMAA, this role leads market data engineering and the development of enterprise data products that support investment professionals, quantitative and research teams. The team works with investment, product, architecture, technology and governance partners to deliver reliable, accessible and AI-ready market data.

Accountabilities

Define and execute the multi-year data engineering strategy and roadmap for PMAA market data products, partnering with the product owner to align priorities with investment needs and enterprise architecture standards.
Own the target-state AWS data platform architecture across ingestion, storage, processing, orchestration, governance and consumption, making design and build-versus-buy decisions that balance scalability, resilience, security and cost.
Lead the development and adoption of enterprise data products across public and private markets, including pricing, reference data, corporate actions and benchmarks, with clear ownership, data contracts, service levels and documentation.
Establish semantic data capabilities, including RDF knowledge graphs on Amazon Neptune, and enable governed access to AI-ready data through Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, agent skills and Amazon Quick.
Ensure reliable, timely and secure data delivery through observability, automated quality controls, incident management, AWS Lake Formation, data lineage and market data licensing and entitlement controls.
Lead agile roadmap delivery and engineering excellence, embedding CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and reusable frameworks while engaging senior stakeholders, investment teams and strategic technology and data partners.
Build, coach and develop an inclusive, high-performing engineering team, fostering accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and career growth.

What You Bring

Undergraduate degree or college diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field; a graduate degree is an asset.
10+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data platforms or software engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams, with demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale, cloud-native data platforms and leading complex agile programs.
Strong understanding of capital markets, investment management and market and reference data, including experience with major data vendors, licensing, entitlements and usage controls; private markets experience is an asset.
Advanced AWS architecture expertise equivalent to Solutions Architect – Professional, including security, IAM, networking, resilience and cost optimization, together with hands-on technical depth in Apache Spark (PySpark or Scala), AWS Glue or EMR, Airflow/MWAA, AWS DMS and Amazon RDS/Aurora.
Expertise in enterprise data product design, AWS Lake Formation governance, data contracts, service levels and consumption patterns, along with RDF, SPARQL, ontology design, Amazon Neptune, MCP servers, agent skills and AI-assisted analytics using Amazon Quick.
Ability to guide engineering teams across cloud-native development, data quality, observability and delivery practices. Experience with lakehouse technologies, Python, SQL, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, data cataloguing, financial ontologies, Amazon Bedrock or GraphRAG is an asset; relevant AWS certifications are also assets.
Inclusive people leadership, sound judgment and strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to investment professionals and executives, influence stakeholders and manage strategic vendor partnerships.

You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.

We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

Inclusion & Accessibility

CPP Investments is committed to equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Attention: Protect Yourself from Fraud

CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.

CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

jobs.description:
About Leo Berwick

Who we are:

Leo Berwick is an innovative mergers and acquisitions consulting firm. We are comprised of top tier, experienced advisors from global law and accounting firms that add value to transactions as trusted partners throughout the deal life cycle. At Leo Berwick, we hire the best and the brightest. Our teams deliver a dedicated and customized service to every client.

As a growth-stage company, we move quickly, work collaboratively, and value people who take initiative and thrive in a fast-paced environment. Our culture is grounded in high performance, continuous learning, and the shared ambition to build something exceptional, together.

What We’re Looking For

Leo Berwick is looking for a Head of Engineering to join our technology team, reporting to the Chief Technology Officer. This role is based in the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, with a hybrid work arrangement of 2 days per week in office.

We’re looking for a deeply technical engineering leader who has built and scaled products in fast-moving SaaS environments and personally led the architecture and delivery of production agentic AI solutions. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between architecture, engineering delivery, and team leadership, and who has the technical credibility to coach and develop experienced Staff and senior engineers.

The Head of Engineering will own end-to-end software development and lead the architecture, delivery, and scaling of our technology platforms. Working closely with senior leadership, engineers, and internal subject matter experts, this individual will lead a small, experienced engineering team across onshore and offshore locations. With an established platform foundation, direct access to internal users, and subject matter expertise already available, the team can build and test products immediately. As the business evolves, the role may expand into leadership of distinct SaaS product areas, with scope to grow into leadership of distinct SaaS product areas.

You’re the right fit for this role if you –

Take ownership, make sound decisions, and turn ambitious product goals into delivered solutions.
Thrive in a fast-moving, evolving environment while maintaining strong engineering discipline.
Communicate openly and clearly with technical teams, business leaders, and other stakeholders.
Invest in coaching others and building a collaborative, accountable, high-performing team.

What You'll Do

Engineering strategy and architecture

Own end-to-end engineering execution across the platform, from technical planning through development, release, and continuous improvement.
Lead architecture decisions and governance across scalable, reliable systems, including oversight of data engineering capabilities.
Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to translate complex needs into achievable product and technical roadmaps.

Product delivery and engineering processes

Build, implement, and continuously improve software development life cycle (SDLC) practices, delivery processes, and engineering quality standards.
Set engineering priorities and deliver products that support internal business needs and future SaaS opportunities.
Lead the architecture and delivery of agentic AI products, applying established agentic engineering expertise to build production-ready solutions.

Team leadership and stakeholder partnership

Lead an initial team of approximately seven to eight predominantly senior engineers across onshore and offshore locations.
Coach senior and staff engineers, strengthen technical ownership, and cultivate a culture of accountability and continuous learning.
Communicate progress, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations effectively to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

What You Bring

10+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial technical leadership and engineering management experience.
Deep architectural expertise in agentic systems and proven experience designing, building, and delivering agentic AI products with production agentic systems you can point to and discuss in depth.
Several years of experience in a fast-paced SaaS or product-building environment.
Proven ability to establish and implement software development life cycle (SDLC) processes, engineering standards, and architectural governance from the ground up.
Demonstrated success building and mentoring high-performing teams of senior and staff engineers.
Strong stakeholder communication skills and a record of delivering effectively through changing business and technology environments.
Ability and interest to learn M&A and private capital transaction workflows and translate domain expertise into practical technology solutions.
A strong technical academic background is preferred, but demonstrated engineering delivery and leadership experience take precedence over a particular degree or designation.

What Success Looks Like In Year One

Own and advance a clear architectural and engineering delivery roadmap for the existing platform and priority products.
Establish consistent SDLC practices, architectural governance, and reliable engineering delivery across the team.
Develop a high-performing senior engineering team that delivers meaningful improvements to internal users and supports future product expansion.
Deliver at least one agentic AI product into production use by internal teams.

Benefits & Perks North America

Unlimited paid time off including 2 weeks of disconnected time each year
Flexible working arrangements – remote and location flexibility
Tuition reimbursement
Attractive medical, dental insurance
Pension & retirement contributions
Monthly fringe benefit stipend (up to $400)
Additional benefits to support your physical and mental wellness

Compensation

This is a permanent full-time role with a base salary range of $250,000 - $300,000 CAD. Placement within the range will depend on relevant experience and scope of responsibility.

Vacancy Statement

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring

Leo Berwick uses artificial intelligence tools to screen and assess applicants for this role.

Leo Berwick is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive and accessible workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and do not discriminate on any ground protected under applicable human rights legislation. Accommodations are available upon request at any stage of the hiring process, in accordance with applicable accessibility and human rights legislation.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

The intended structure of this role is a non-relocation secondment. By nature of this structure, existing employees will remain aligned to their current location, level, service line/business area, salary, and compensation/performance review cycle, for the duration of their secondment to Deloitte Global.

The Director, Global Hosting Services, defines, leads, and governs Deloitte Global’s private-cloud hosting strategy, data center and cloud networking services, and Global Wide Area Network (GWAN). The role oversees secure, resilient connectivity among Deloitte Global hosting facilities, member-firm environments, and cloud service provider (CSP) hubs across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud. The Director also leads CSP cost reporting and invoice reconciliation through the Deloitte Cloud Services (DCS) Cloud Business Office, supports agile delivery of platform and network enhancements, and ensures operational excellence and rapid incident response across these services.

Key Responsibilities:

Deloitte Cloud Services (DCS) Networking

Oversee the design and implementation of network architecture supporting DCS hubs, connectivity among Deloitte environments, the internet, and cloud service providers, and secure access to cloud-hosted services, including firewalls and load balancers:
Multi-CSP connectivity
Inter-CSP connectivity
Secure hybrid-cloud IPv4/IPv6 connectivity
CSP inter-region global connectivity
CSP intra-region scalability
IP addressing management

Lead the team in delivering these services, with operational excellence and 24/7 monitoring and support.
Drive continuous improvement and automation through API enhancements and agentic AI solutions to reduce service-delivery time and enable proactive monitoring, rapid issue identification, and resolution.

What will your typical day look like?

Interfirm Network Service (GWAN)

Lead the Interfirm Network Service (INS), providing seamless, secure, resilient, and optimized connectivity among member firms and across public-cloud environments.
Develop solution roadmaps and architectures that address evolving business needs, technology requirements, cybersecurity threats, and demand for high-performance, low-latency connectivity.
Drive operational service excellence, support member-firm disaster recovery testing exercises, and adapt connectivity options as firms implement local in-country WAN and SD-WAN solutions.
Manage IPv4/IPv6 address allocation for member firms and countries.

Deloitte Cloud Services (DCS) Cloud Business Office

Provide scaled agile delivery services supporting product enhancements for DCS platform, product, and networking teams, as well as Global Enterprise Cloud Management Services.
Lead Cloud Business Office delivery of CSP cost insights for member firms, CSP invoice reconciliation, and billing to Deloitte entities. Support FinOps through cost-optimization recommendations, CSP cost reporting, and AI token-ledger reporting.

Risk Management & Compliance

Ensure all data center and cloud-platform solutions comply with global regulatory, security, and privacy standards.
Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation strategies.
Serve as a trusted liaison to Cyber teams on cloud-related matters, champion Cyber initiatives, and review and provide feedback on Cyber standards and programs.

Private Cloud Delivery (Colocation Services)

Define and continuously evolve Deloitte Global’s private-hosting and colocation strategy, including regional services in the United States and Germany. Adapt the strategy to emerging requirements such as zero-trust networking, private infrastructure supporting GPU-intensive AI workloads, and future quantum-computing capabilities.
Lead the team in delivering these services while maintaining operational excellence and compliance with audit, SOC, and ISO requirements.
Develop private-cloud roadmaps, standards, and reference architectures, and establish governance frameworks, policies, and cost-recovery processes.

About The Team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in what is but rather what can be to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Enough About Us, Let’s Talk About You

15 or more years of progressive technology leadership, experience leading infrastructure teams and developing strategy, architecture, or platforms, setting priorities and goals to meet global business goals and objectives

Proven experience in designing, governing, and operating enterprise-scale private-hosting and global networks.
Strong background in automation and operational leadership.
Ability to plan, organize, and manage multiple responsibilities; provide technical direction through project completion; and deliver high-quality outcomes within target timeframes.
Demonstrated ability to drive change and influence senior stakeholders.
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills.
Experience managing global, distributed teams.
Deep understanding of the latest technology, market and trends

Total Rewards

10+ years of experience in enterprise technology leadership within a consulting, systems integration, or agency environment—with at least 3–4 years specifically in Shopify Plus or a comparable enterprise commerce platform.

AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, TOGAF, SAFe, PMP, or equivalent—demonstrating both platform-level and enterprise architecture credentials.

This role combines deep financial expertise with strong executive presence, business acumen, and the ability to influence across a complex, franchise system.

As we shift toward a Product Operating Model, this leader will modernize FP&A into a proactive, insight-driven, technology-enabled function. The VP, FP&A must be both a relationship-builder and a systems thinker — equally comfortable diving into models, simplifying complexity, coaching a tactical FP&A team, and advising senior leaders with confidence and credibility.

CFO Partnership & Executive Influence

Serve as trusted advisor to the CFO, providing structure, insight, guidance, and challenge on key decisions.
Strengthen the CFO’s influence by preparing high-quality narratives, decision frameworks, and financial storytelling for the Executive.
Bring clarity to ambiguity — shaping options, risks, and trade-offs in a way that enables confident decision-making.

The Opportunity
Squiala First Nation is seeking an experienced and relationship-focused Chief Administrative Officer (CAO)
to provide strategic and operational leadership across the Nation’s administration.

This is an important time for Squiala First Nation. As the Nation continues to grow its programs, services and administrative capacity, the CAO will work closely with Chief & Council, managers, employees, community members, funders and external partners to strengthen systems, support effective service
delivery and advance the Nation’s vision and priorities.

The CAO will be a trusted administrative leader who understands the distinct but interconnected roles of governance and administration. Reporting directly to Chief & Council, the CAO will translate strategic direction into practical plans, support managers in delivering high-quality programs and services, and ensure the administration operates in an ethical, transparent, accountable and culturally respectful manner.
This is a full-time, in person, executive position based at the Squiala First Nation administration office in Chilliwack, British Columbia
.

The role generally works regular business hours, with flexibility required to respond to organizational and community needs. Occasional evening or extended hours may be required. The position includes local, provincial and national travel, anticipated to be approximately 20%.

What this role holds
The CAO provides leadership across the Nation’s administrative operations, including:
Finance
Housing
Health and Wellness
Lands
Office Administration

The CAO will lead and support the managers responsible for these areas, while remaining accountable to Chief & Council for the overall effectiveness of the Nation’s administration.
This role requires someone who can bring people together, establish clear priorities, strengthen organizational systems and build trust across the workplace and community. The successful candidate will balance strategic thinking with practical implementation and will be comfortable navigating complex financial, operational, governance and community matters.

The CAO will work through a Two-Eyed Seeing approach
, recognizing and valuing Stó:lō ways of knowing alongside effective Western administrative practices. The role requires cultural humility, sound judgment and a genuine commitment to learning about Squiala’s history, culture, values, priorities and future vision.

What you will do
Strategic and Organizational Leadership

Work with Chief & Council to translate the Nation’s vision and strategic priorities into operational plans, goals and measurable results.
Lead the Nation’s administration through the management team, ensuring departments work collaboratively and priorities, budgets and timelines remain aligned.
Provide positive, informed change leadership as the Nation evolves and realigns its organizational structure, ensuring employees and leaders are kept informed, engaged and supported through clear, consistent and respectful communication.
Strengthen organizational policies, systems and capacity while monitoring performance, identifying emerging risks and recommending practical improvements.

Leadership of Managers and Employees

Provide direction, support and accountability to the Finance, Housing, Health & Wellness, Lands and Office Managers.
Lead staffing, performance management, employee development and succession planning while coaching managers to effectively lead their teams.
Foster a positive, inclusive, culturally safe and trauma-informed workplace grounded in communication, collaboration and accountability.

Financial Oversight

Provide leadership to the Finance Manager and remain accountable to Chief & Council for the integrity and timeliness of the Nation’s financial information.
Oversee annual and multi-year budgeting, financial planning, internal controls and financial performance.
Ensure financial policies, funding agreements and reporting requirements are met while identifying and addressing financial and funding risks.

Community and External Relationships

Build respectful relationships with community members, Elders, Knowledge Keepers, funders, governments and external partners.
Support meaningful community engagement and maintain productive relationships that advance the Nation’s priorities and opportunities.
Represent the administration on operational matters as authorized, while respecting Chief & Council’s leadership on political, rights and governance matters.

Governance and Accountability

Operate within the strategic direction, policies, budgets and delegated authorities established by Chief & Council.
Maintain a clear and respectful distinction between the governance role of Chief & Council and the administrative leadership role of the CAO.
Ensure Chief & Council receives timely, accurate information for decision-making and that significant financial, legal, operational and reputational risks are appropriately escalated.

Who you are
You are a practical, thoughtful leader who builds trust through listening, consistency and follow-through. You bring:
Strong understanding of the roles of Chief & Council and administration, with respect for First Nations governance and community priorities.
Cultural humility and the ability to value Indigenous ways of knowing alongside effective administrative practices.
Proven experience leading managers, teams and complex organizational operations.
Strong financial and business acumen, including budgeting, funding, reporting and risk management.
Excellent communication, diplomacy and judgment, with the ability to navigate sensitive and complex environments.
A collaborative leadership style focused on accountability, positive relationships and a culturally safe, inclusive workplace.

What you bring

Experience working with First Nations communities or Indigenous organizations
, with strong knowledge of Indigenous governance, community priorities, culturally informed leadership and financial stewardship.
Familiarity with Squiala First Nation, Stó:lō communities, culture and values
is an asset.
At least five years of progressive senior or executive leadership experience, including leading managers, teams, programs and organizational operations.
Strong financial leadership experience, including budgeting, fiscal planning, financial reporting and reporting to a Board, Council or governing body.
Experience strengthening organizational systems and supporting organizations through growth, change or structural realignment.
A degree in Business Administration, Finance, Public Administration or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Knowledge of applicable federal and provincial legislation, regulatory and funding requirements.
A valid Class 5 BC driver’s licence and the ability to successfully complete a vulnerable-sector criminal record check.

An equivalent combination of First Nations experience, leadership experience, education and demonstrated knowledge
will be considered.

What we offer

An opportunity to use your skills and leadership to make a meaningful difference in a forward-moving First Nation community.

The Director works closely with Facilities and Protection, Finance, Contracts and Procurement, Research and Collections, Experience and Engagement, IM/IT and other Museum teams and, as a member of the Management Group, contributes to corporate strategic planning and participates in setting corporate objectives.

Relevant du Vice-président ou de la Vice-présidente des affaires stratégiques et corporatives, le directeur ou la directrice des projets d’immobilisation et de la gestion des projets est responsable de la planification, de la direction, de la surveillance, de l'exécution et de l'évaluation des projets d'immobilisations du Musée, y compris tous les projets d'immobilisation liés aux trois principaux biens immobiliers sous l’intendance du Musée, ainsi que de la planification et de la direction du bureau de gestion de projet (BGP) du Musée. Les responsabilités de ce poste incluent la gestion, le maintien et la mise en œuvre du Plan d'investissement à long terme (PILT) du Musée et du cadre de gestion des actifs, pour la conception et la gestion du modèle de mise en œuvre des projets d’investissement, ainsi que pour la réalisation des projets d’immobilisation et autres projets corporatifs du Musée via le BGP et le Cadre de gestion de projet (CGP) du MCN. Le directeur ou la directrice supervise l'élaboration, la mise à jour et l’exécution du plan annuel d'investissement et du plan pluriannuel d'approvisionnement d’investissement et d’immobilisation; gère le cycle de vie du budget d'investissement, incluant les approbations étapes, les contingences et le budget administratif du programme; établit et gère les offres permanentes de services professionnels ainsi que les services gouvernementaux tels que les services de conservation du patrimoine des Services publics et Approvisionnement Canada (SPAC); dirige le chef ou la cheffe des projets d'immobilisation et de la gestion des actifs, qui gère le BGP; et gère la capacité interne de livraison d’investissement et d’immobilisation du Musée. A construction company is seeking an experienced Director of Operations
to lead and support its construction activities in Ottawa and the surrounding area.

Our work includes civil construction, excavation and site development for commercial, institutional, residential and infrastructure projects. This is an opportunity for an experienced construction leader to play a key role in operational planning, project performance, team development and client relationships.

The Director of Operations will provide leadership across multiple construction projects, working closely with project managers, superintendents, estimators, field crews and senior leadership.

7+ years of progressive experience in accounting services or delivery leadership
Experience leading accounting delivery teams
Hands-on technical accounting knowledge, not only management experience

Month end is the most demanding period and falls within the first ten business days. It eases considerably after that.

Most of your career has been in industry rather than public accounting
You want to step back from hands on technical accounting
You need your function defined for you before you start
You avoid difficult conversations with clients or with your team
Working full EST hours would be a strain on your health or your life

Vous êtes responsable de la prestation des services comptables : l’expérience client, l’efficacité des processus techniques, la qualité de la prestation et le rendement des équipes de prestation. Vous décidez comment le travail se fait, vous vous assurez qu’il est bien fait, et vous êtes responsable de la relation client qui l’entoure.

Aujourd’hui, cela fait partie d’un poste qui cumule plusieurs fonctions, et certains volets, comme la rétroaction des clients et la détection précoce des signes de surcharge dans l’équipe, n’ont aucun responsable attitré.

Vous travaillez selon l’horaire complet de l’Est parce que vous êtes en contact direct avec les fondateurs, votre équipe et les clients tout au long de la journée. C’est un poste opérationnel. Vous devez avoir la profondeur technique nécessaire pour réviser le travail vous-même, et pas seulement pour gérer les personnes qui le font.

⭐ Exigences

Au moins 90 % de votre carrière en cabinet d’expertise comptable : Big 4, cabinet de taille intermédiaire, régional ou boutique. La comptabilité en entreprise, au sein de l’équipe des finances d’une seule société, ne compte pas.

Vous avez été responsable de relations clients : gérer les attentes, annoncer de mauvaises nouvelles et repérer les problèmes de qualité de service avant que le client ne les remarque
Vous avez défini et bâti une fonction vous-même, sans qu’elle vous soit remise clé en main

✨ Atouts

Expérience en comptabilité du commerce électronique : Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop
A2X, QBO, Xero, Bookkeep ou outils similaires
Un parcours démontrant d’excellentes aptitudes en gestion d’équipe
Expérience concrète dans la création ou l’amélioration de procédures et de documentation de processus
Capacité de niveau vice-présidence : travail stratégique au-delà de la prestation

✅ Ce que vous ferez

Être responsable des procédures techniques : gabarits, intégrations Shopify, TikTok Shop et Amazon, extraction des rapports, A2X par rapport à Bookkeep, et les améliorer en continu
Être responsable de l’expérience client : points de suivi, qualité du service, occasions de vente additionnelle et retour des clients vers l’équipe
Travailler avec la gestionnaire de la qualité comptable pour garder la chaîne serrée : les constats du contrôle qualité remontent à la formation, et les lacunes de formation remontent à notre façon de recruter
Maintenir des charges de travail viables, signaler tôt lorsque des personnes sont en difficulté, et bâtir des systèmes qui font ressortir les problèmes avant qu’ils ne deviennent des crises
Être responsable des logiciels et des outils de la fonction services : ce dont nous avons besoin, ce qui est redondant et ce que cela coûte

🔍 À quoi ressemble vraiment le poste

La fin de mois est la période la plus exigeante et se situe dans les dix premiers jours ouvrables. La pression diminue considérablement par la suite.
Vous obtenez une réelle prise en charge dès le premier jour. C’est l’avantage, et c’est aussi l’attente.

new_jobs.title: Product Growth Director, Investors Edge
new_jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

Our Digital Product team is focused on creating intuitive, engaging experiences that help clients discover value, build confidence, and develop long-term digital habits. As a Product Growth Director, you'll lead the strategy for how clients onboard, activate, engage, and re-engage across the IE digital platform. You'll work at the intersection of Product, Data, and User Experience to turn client behavior and insights into measurable growth outcomes. In this role, you'll drive a more continuous, product-led growth approach by advancing experimentation, personalization, and in-product engagement strategies. You'll partner closely with Product, User Experience, Analytics, Marketing Technology, Delivery, and business teams to identify opportunities, test ideas, and optimize the signed-in client experience. You'll also help shape the future of intelligent engagement across the platform, ensuring clients receive relevant, timely, and valuable digital experiences.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

The expected annualized base salary range for this role is $128,000 to $166,100.

The base salary is determined by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s skills, experience, and job-related knowledge, as well as geographic location and specific business needs. Our compensation philosophy supports ongoing growth and development, enabling progression within the salary range as team members advance in their roles.

In addition to base pay, compensation for this role includes participation in an annual discretionary incentive or bonus program.

We are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation opportunities for all employees and we encourage open conversations about compensation throughout the recruitment process.

How You'll Succeed

Growth strategy leadership - Lead and evolve key growth metrics across onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, and re-engagement journeys. Translate business goals and client needs into measurable product-led growth strategies.
Experimentation and optimization - Build a culture of continuous experimentation by defining hypotheses, running tests, measuring outcomes, and iterating based on results. Use evidence-based decision making to improve adoption and long-term engagement.
Personalized client experiences - Design and optimize contextual in-product experiences and personalized engagement strategies that improve feature discovery and ongoing adoption. Help shape future-state personalization capabilities across the platform.
Data-driven insights - Use behavioral data, segmentation, and client insights to identify friction points, uncover opportunities, and improve journey performance. Communicate findings clearly to influence roadmap and experience decisions.
Cross-functional partnership - Collaborate with Product, User Experience, Analytics, Marketing Technology, Delivery, Business Strategy, and Operations teams to execute growth opportunities. Integrate offers, pricing updates, content, and service messaging into cohesive in-app user journeys.
Omnichannel engagement - Coordinate engagement strategies across in-app, push, email, and other digital touchpoints to create connected client experiences. Ensure engagement tactics align with product goals and support long-term client value.

Who You Are

You have relevant experience. You bring approximately 5-10 years of experience in product growth, lifecycle engagement, customer relationship management, digital product, or growth strategy roles. You have a strong track record of improving onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention in digital product environments.
You give meaning to data. You enjoy investigating complex problems and making sense of information. You communicate detailed information in a meaningful way.
You act like an owner. You thrive when you're empowered to take initiative, go above and beyond, and deliver results.
Your influence makes a difference. You know that relationships and networks are essential to success. You inspire outcomes by sharing your expertise.
You can demonstrate experience in experimentation, personalization, lifecycle engagement, behavioural segmentation, and digital engagement platforms such as Braze, Salesforce, or similar technologies. It’s an asset if you have experience in fintech, subscription platforms, consumer apps, or other modern digital product environments.
You live your values. You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com
CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.
You need to be legally eligible to work at the location(s) specified above and, where applicable, must have a valid work or study permit.
We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency).
We use artificial intelligence tools during the recruitment process. Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us.
